text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: By the sky with its constellations.
text_1989: The sky and its galaxies.
text_ref: The sky and its galaxies.

text_1981: By the promised day.
text_1989: The promised day.
text_ref: The promised day.

text_1981: By the witness and the witnessed.
text_1989: The witness and the witnessed.
text_ref: The witness and the witnessed.

text_1981: The people of the canyon were doomed.
text_1989: Woe to the people of the canyon.
text_ref: Woe to the people of the canyon.

text_1981: They set up a flaming fire.
text_1989: They ignited a blazing fire.
text_ref: They ignited a blazing fire.

text_1981: They sat around it.
text_1989: Then sat around it.
text_ref: Then sat around it.

text_1981: Watching the believers burn. 8.
text_1989: To watch the burning of the believers
text_ref: To watch the burning of the believers.

text_1981: They hated them for no other reason than believing in GOD, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.
text_1989: They hated them for no other reason than believing in GOD, the Al­ mighty, the Praiseworthy.
text_ref: They hated them for no other reason than believing in GOD, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.

text_1981: To Him belong the heavens and the earth; and God witnesses all things. 10.
text_1989: To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. witnesses all things.
text_ref: To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. And GOD witnesses all things.

text_1981: Surely, those who persecute the believing men and women, then fail to repent, have incurred the retribution of Gehenna; they have incurred the retribution of burning.
text_1989: Surely, those who persecute the believing men and women, then fail to repent, have incurred the retribu­ tion of Gehenna; they have incurred the retribution of burning.
text_ref: Surely, those who persecute the believing men and women, then fail to repent, have incurred the retribution of Gehenna; they have incurred the retribution of burning.

text_1981: Surely, those who believed and led a righteous life, have deserved gardens with flowing streams. This is the greatest triumph.
text_1989: Surely, those who believed and led a righteous life, have deserved gardens with flowing streams. the greatest triumph.
text_ref: Surely, those who believed and led a righteous life, have deserved gardens with flowing streams. This is the greatest triumph.

text_1981: The blow of your Lord is severe.
text_1989: Indeed, your Lord’s blow is severe.
text_ref: Indeed, your Lord's blow is severe.

text_1981: He is the one who initiates and resurrects.
text_1989: He is the One who initiates and repeats.
text_ref: He is the One who initiates and repeats.

text_1981: He is the forgiver, the compassionate.
text_1989: And He is the Forgiving, Most Kind.
text_ref: And He is the Forgiving, Most Kind.

text_1981: Possessor of the glorious throne.
text_1989: Possessor of the glorious throne.
text_ref: Possessor of the glorious throne.

text_1981: Doer of anything He wills.
text_1989: Doer of whatever He wills.
text_ref: Doer of whatever He wills.

text_1981: Did you receive the history of the troops?
text_1989: Did you note the history of the troops?
text_ref: Did you note the history of the troops?

text_1981: Pharaoh and Thamood?
text_1989: Pharaoh and Thamoud?
text_ref: Pharaoh and Thamûd?

text_1981: Those who disbelieve are rejecting (the truth).
text_1989: Those who disbelieve are plagued with denial.
text_ref: Those who disbelieve are plagued with denial.

text_1981: God is completely surrounding them. 21.
text_1989: GOD is fully aware of them.
text_ref: GOD is fully aware of them.

text_1981: Indeed, it is a glorious Quran.
text_1989: Indeed, it is a glorious Quran.
text_ref: Indeed, it is a glorious Quran.

text_1981: In a protected record.
text_1989: In a preserved master tablet.
text_ref: In a preserved master tablet.
